Normative statement: Public and downstream tests MUST prove prepared/custom explicit global and bounded key parts, plan inspection, finite validation, redaction, and no-governor failure remain available while normal generated DSL cannot construct key parts.

Normative statement: Existing and focused deterministic tests MUST reprove hook/credential/limiter ordering, one acquisition per Concord attempt, atomic reservation, cancellation, recovery, observation, cooldown, finite state, no-op, custom, and fail-closed fallback behavior after the generated plan transition.

Independent operative clause: Every canonical arbitrary request/response specification, universal metadata, `ByteStream`, prepared generic, page-response capability, records, CSV, and NDJSON example presented as valid MUST have compile evidence under its exact feature,
Independent operative clause: public/generated Rustdoc MUST exclude private integration and sensitive sentinels.
Normative statement: Tests MUST prefer public compilation and observable runtime behavior over private source shape.
Normative statement: Clippy and Rustdoc warnings MUST fail release validation.
Normative statement: Maintained release test execution MUST use zero automatic retries.
Normative statement: Release tests MUST NOT require live external APIs, real credentials, pre-existing proxy configuration, externally managed network listeners, or Internet access.
Independent operative clause: Tests MAY create and own ephemeral loopback HTTP, HTTPS, mTLS, and proxy listeners
Independent operative clause: MAY use process-scoped environment configuration when the behavior is deterministic, isolated, and restored or confined to a child process.
Independent operative clause: Maintained unit and integration test execution MUST use Nextest with no omitted default test set,
Independent operative clause: Cargo-spawning tests MUST use bounded concurrency; `cargo test` is reserved for doctests.

Normative statement: Before broad body, authentication, rate-limit, or pagination surfaces are stabilized, one generated endpoint MUST execute end to end through the real managed Reqwest executor under deterministic test control.
Normative statement: A release MUST NOT be declared conforming while any normative requirement lacks passing or approved waived evidence.
